metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from January 27, 2017 to February 2, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized within ±15 days around each target date over a rectangle covering Lake Menindee, Australia (142.1E–142.7E, 32.9S–32.1S). If empty or fully masked, fall back to Landsat 8/9 L2. If still empty, widen to ±60 days.
2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask clouds/cirrus using QA60 bits. For Landsat 8/9 L2, mask clouds, cirrus, cloud shadow, and dilated cloud using QA_PIXEL. Compute MNDWI and classify water (MNDWI > 0.3).
3. Logic: 
   - Check collection sizes; if all zero after fallback/widening → C1.
   - Count valid pixels after masking at 1000 m; if zero for all attempts → C2.
   - Compute water area via pixelArea sum; if result is null/NaN → C3.
   - Compare water area (2019 vs 2017). If decreased → A: Yes, else B: No.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([142.1, -32.9, 142.7, -32.1], null, false);
    const targetDates = [
      {label: '2017-01-27'},
      {label: '2019-02-02'}
    ];
    const baseWindowDays = 15; // ±15 days
    const wideWindowDays = 60; // ±60 days
    const scale = 1000;
    const mndwiThresh = 0.3;

    // 2. Helper functions
    function maskS2SR(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function mndwiFromS2(img) {
      const g = img.select('B3').multiply(0.0001);
      const sw = img.select('B11').multiply(0.0001);
      return g.subtract(sw).divide(g.add(sw)).rename('mndwi');
    }
    function getS2Col(start, end) {
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end);
    }

    function scaleMaskLandsatL2(img) {
      // Apply scale factors
      const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
        .copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // Dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // Cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // Cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0));     // Cloud shadow
      return scaled.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function mndwiFromLandsat(img) {
      const g = img.select('SR_B3');
      const sw = img.select('SR_B6');
      return g.subtract(sw).divide(g.add(sw)).rename('mndwi');
    }
    function getLandsatCol(start, end) {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2');
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2');
      return l8.merge(l9).filterBounds(geom).filterDate(start, end);
    }

    async function tryDataset(dateStr, windowDays, dataset) {
      const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(windowDays + 1, 'day'); // inclusive-ish
      let col, size, avgCloud, usedName;
      if (dataset === 'S2') {
        col = getS2Col(start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        avgCloud = size > 0 ? await col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').getInfo() : null;
        if (size === 0) return {ok: false, anyImages: false, dataset: 'S2'};
        const mosaic = col.map(maskS2SR).median().clip(geom);
        const mndwi = mndwiFromS2(mosaic);
        const validCount = await mndwi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('mndwi').getInfo();
        if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
          return {ok: false, anyImages: true, validCount: 0, dataset: 'S2', size, avgCloud};
        }
        const water = mndwi.gt(mndwiThresh).rename('water');
        const waterAreaM2 = await water.updateMask(water)
          .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
          }).get('water').getInfo();
        const areaKm2 = waterAreaM2 ? (waterAreaM2 / 1e6) : null;
        if (areaKm2 === null || isNaN(areaKm2)) {
          return {ok: false, anyImages: true, validCount, dataset: 'S2', size, avgCloud, calcFail: true};
        }
        usedName = 'S2';
        return {ok: true, used: usedName, size, avgCloud, validCount, areaKm2, windowDays};
      } else {
        col = getLandsatCol(start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        avgCloud = size > 0 ? await col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER').getInfo() : null;
        if (size === 0) return {ok: false, anyImages: false, dataset: 'Landsat'};
        const mosaic = col.map(scaleMaskLandsatL2).median().clip(geom);
        const mndwi = mndwiFromLandsat(mosaic);
        const validCount = await mndwi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('mndwi').getInfo();
        if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
          return {ok: false, anyImages: true, validCount: 0, dataset: 'Landsat', size, avgCloud};
        }
        const water = mndwi.gt(mndwiThresh).rename('water');
        const waterAreaM2 = await water.updateMask(water)
          .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
          }).get('water').getInfo();
        const areaKm2 = waterAreaM2 ? (waterAreaM2 / 1e6) : null;
        if (areaKm2 === null || isNaN(areaKm2)) {
          return {ok: false, anyImages: true, validCount, dataset: 'Landsat', size, avgCloud, calcFail: true};
        }
        usedName = 'Landsat';
        return {ok: true, used: usedName, size, avgCloud, validCount, areaKm2, windowDays};
      }
    }

    async function getWaterStatsForDate(dateStr) {
      // Attempt order: S2 (±15d) -> Landsat (±15d) -> S2 (±60d) -> Landsat (±60d)
      const attempts = [
        await tryDataset(dateStr, baseWindowDays, 'S2'),
        await tryDataset(dateStr, baseWindowDays, 'Landsat'),
        await tryDataset(dateStr, wideWindowDays, 'S2'),
        await tryDataset(dateStr, wideWindowDays, 'Landsat')
      ];
      let anyImages = false;
      let anyValid = false;
      let calcFail = false;
      let chosen = null;
      for (const a of attempts) {
        if (a && a.anyImages) anyImages = true;
        if (a && a.calcFail) calcFail = true;
        if (a && a.ok) { chosen = a; anyValid = true; break; }
      }
      if (!anyImages) return {status: 'C1'};
      if (!anyValid) return {status: 'C2'};
      if (calcFail) return {status: 'C3'};
      return {status: 'OK', ...chosen};
    }

    // 3. Run for both dates
    const stats = [];
    for (const d of targetDates) {
      const s = await getWaterStatsForDate(d.label);
      stats.push({date: d.label, ...s});
    }

    // 4. Check for failure cases
    if (stats.some(s => s.status === 'C1')) {
      console.log('One or both dates: Empty collection after attempts.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (stats.some(s => s.status === 'C2')) {
      console.log('One or both dates: No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (stats.some(s => s.status === 'C3') || stats.some(s => s.areaKm2 === null || isNaN(s.areaKm2))) {
      console.log('Calculation failed (null/NaN).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence
    stats.forEach(s => {
      const avgCloudStr = (s.avgCloud !== null && s.avgCloud !== undefined) ? s.avgCloud.toFixed(1) : 'n/a';
      console.log(`${s.date} | Used: ${s.used} | imgs: ${s.size} | avgCloud: ${avgCloudStr}% | window: ±${s.windowDays}d | Valid px: ${s.validCount} | Water km2: ${s.areaKm2.toFixed(2)}`);
    });
    const s2017 = stats[0];
    const s2019 = stats[1];
    const delta = s2019.areaKm2 - s2017.areaKm2;
    const pct = s2017.areaKm2 > 0 ? (delta / s2017.areaKm2) * 100 : null;
    const pctStr = (pct === null || isNaN(pct)) ? 'n/a' : `${pct.toFixed(1)}%`;
    console.log(`Change (2019 vs 2017): Δkm2=${delta.toFixed(2)}, Δ%=${pctStr}`);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (delta < 0) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
